gpsConsents.termsText:
You are signing in to BioRemedy Front Line on a phone that is not company-issued, for one dispatch job.

While this sign-on is active, Front Line may record your phone's GPS position when you tap a location action (check-in, sample point, field ping). It does not track you in the background.

Each position is stored with this job, the time, this device, and this agreement, and is kept for 90 days unless a project record requires it longer.

This sign-on expires when the job window closes. You can decline now, and you can stop at any time by signing out.

opportunities.name: Diesel release — saddle tank rupture, Round Rock yard
opportunities.opportunityName: Diesel release — saddle tank rupture, Round Rock yard
opportunities.customerNeed: Roughly 120 gallons of diesel from a ruptured saddle tank across the yard pavement and into the drainage swale.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Contain and recover free product, pressure-wash and vacuum the pavement, treat the swale with Micro-Bac-S, sample the swale soil, and document for the insurance claim.

opportunities.name: Hutto Crossing — fire debris and hydraulic fluid cleanup
opportunities.opportunityName: Hutto Crossing — fire debris and hydraulic fluid cleanup
opportunities.customerNeed: Burned debris pile and a hydraulic fluid stain across the rear parking lot after a dumpster fire and a leaking compactor.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Skid steer and roll-off for debris, degrease and pressure-wash the stain, apply bacteria to the stained asphalt.

opportunities.name: Taylor valve site crude release — excavation and treatment
opportunities.opportunityName: Taylor valve site crude release — excavation and treatment
opportunities.customerNeed: Estimated 40 bbl crude release at a valve site; impacted soil to be excavated, treated on-site with bacteria and backfilled; stock tank protected.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Three-stage program: containment and free-product recovery, excavation with on-site biological treatment windrows, confirmation sampling and backfill. Daily field tickets.

opportunities.name: Pflugerville Inn — subsurface investigation (soil borings)
opportunities.customerNeed: Buyer due diligence flagged a former fuel tank and a failed grease line; needs soil data before closing.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Six direct-push borings to 12 ft, TPH/BTEX on two intervals each, summary letter with a closure recommendation.

opportunities.name: Garage B — transformer oil wash-down (night)
opportunities.customerNeed: Transformer oil tracked across three levels by vehicle tires.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Two-night hot-water pressure-wash and degrease with wash-water recovery and disposal.

opportunities.name: Building 2 crawlspace sewage cleanout and bioremediation
opportunities.opportunityName: Building 2 crawlspace sewage cleanout and bioremediation
opportunities.customerNeed: Sewage backup pooled under Building 2; odor complaints from tenants.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Vacuum pump-out, remove saturated vapor barrier, disinfect, apply Micro-Bac-S, and photo-document before/after for the association.

opportunities.name: Amenity pond bioremediation — three treatments
opportunities.customerNeed: Fish kill and odor after a summer algae bloom.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Night application of Mega-Bac X from the spray trailer, three treatments 30 days apart, with dissolved-oxygen readings.

opportunities.name: Hazardous materials management & spill response — RFP 202519
opportunities.opportunityName: Hazardous materials management & spill response — RFP 202519
opportunities.customerNeed: City-wide on-call hazardous materials and spill response.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Standing services agreement at 2026 rate-sheet pricing with a 4-hour emergency minimum, quarterly reviews.

opportunities.name: Hydraulic oil release — Public Works Service Center wash bay
opportunities.opportunityName: Hydraulic oil release — Public Works Service Center wash bay
opportunities.customerNeed: Refuse truck blew a hydraulic line in the wash bay; oil in the bay and the oil-water separator.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Absorb and recover, pump and clean the separator, dispose under the city's waste profile. Under the RFP 202519 agreement.

opportunities.name: Diesel sheen — Austin Ave storm drain
opportunities.opportunityName: Diesel sheen — Austin Ave storm drain
opportunities.customerNeed: Diesel sheen in the storm drain after a delivery truck overfill; Fire Department boomed the outfall.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Recover product from the inlet and outfall, replace the FD boom, treat the residual with Micro-Bac-S.

opportunities.name: South lagoon liner tear — sludge removal and repair
opportunities.opportunityName: South lagoon liner tear — sludge removal and repair
opportunities.customerNeed: Liner tear along the south bank; sludge has to come out before the liner crew can patch.
opportunities.proposedSolution: Vac-out and dewater sludge, Balfour excavator support for subgrade repair, liner patch by the liner contractor, Republic haul-off of dewatered sludge.
